NSCameraUsageDescription: AltUten uses the camera to scan grocery barcodes and photograph products for review.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AltUten lets you attach a product photo when reporting a barcode.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We would like to give you the best experience. To make AltUten faster and more suited to you, we use your location for language and local product results.
